name: What are the potential consequences of ignoring a running water meter?

mainEntity.name: What are the potential consequences of ignoring a running water meter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ignoring a water meter that continues to run when all water is off can lead to severe consequences. Financially, you'll face escalating water bills due to continuous water waste. Structurally, hidden leaks can cause significant damage to your home's foundation, walls, and flooring, leading to expensive and extensive repairs. Furthermore, constant moisture can promote mold and mildew growth, which can impact indoor air quality and pose health risks. It's best to address leaks promptly to mitigate these risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ignoring a running water meter leads to high water bills, severe property damage like foundation issues, and mold growth, posing health risks.
